Title: BigQuery
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-1
Content: BigQuery is a Google managed serverless data warehouse. The BigQuery JDBC driver is not bundled with this connector and therefore must be added to the Java execution classpath. See the Custom Driver config section for more details. The JDBC connector supports a number of BigQuery specific features. To enable these features solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to custom, with solidatus.jdbc.driver-class set to the BigQuery JDBC class. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to bigquery.
Title: JDBC URL Formatting
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/snowflake/configuration/jdbc-url-formatting
Content: Typical connection string structure:

jdbc:bigquery://https://www.googleapis.com/bigquery/v2:443;ProjectId={PROJECT_ID}

Example using service account authentication:

jdbc:bigquery://https://www.googleapis.com/bigquery/v2:443;ProjectId={PROJECT_ID};OAuthType=0;OAuthServiceAcctEmail={SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL};OAuthPvtKeyPath={KEY_PATH}

Please see for more information: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/odbc-jdbc-drivers
